title: Manasseh and Amon

questions.question: How old was Manasseh when he began to reign?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 33:1 (ESV): "Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign..."

questions.question: What evil did Manasseh do?
options: Built high places, erected altars to Baals, practiced sorcery
questions.correctAnswer: Built high places, erected altars to Baals, practiced sorcery
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 33:3-6 (ESV): "For he rebuilt the high places... erected altars to the Baals... practiced soothsaying..."

questions.question: What happened to Manasseh?
options: The king of Assyria took him captive in hooks and bound him with chains of bronze
questions.correctAnswer: The king of Assyria took him captive in hooks and bound him with chains of bronze
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 33:11 (ESV): "...took Manasseh with hooks and bound him with chains of bronze and brought him to Babylon."

questions.question: What did Manasseh do in his distress?
options: He humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers and prayed
questions.correctAnswer: He humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers and prayed
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 33:12 (ESV): "...he entreated the favor of the LORD his God and humbled himself greatly..."

questions.question: What did God do in response to Manasseh's prayer?
options: He moved him and brought him again to Jerusalem into his kingdom
questions.correctAnswer: He moved him and brought him again to Jerusalem into his kingdom
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 33:13 (ESV): "...And God was moved by his entreaty... and brought him again to Jerusalem into his kingdom."

questions.question: What did Manasseh know after his restoration?
options: That he was a great king
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 33:13 (ESV): "...Then Manasseh knew that the LORD was God."

questions.question: How long did Manasseh reign?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 33:1 (ESV): "...and he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem."

questions.question: Who reigned after Manasseh?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 33:20 (ESV): "...and Amon his son reigned in his place."

questions.question: How old was Amon when he began to reign?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 33:21 (ESV): "Amon was twenty-two years old when he began to reign..."

questions.question: Did Amon humble himself like his father?
options: No, he became more and more guilty
questions.correctAnswer: No, he became more and more guilty
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 33:23 (ESV): "And he did not humble himself before the LORD, as Manasseh his father had humbled himself..."

questions.question: How did Amon die?
options: His servants conspired against him and put him to death in his house
questions.correctAnswer: His servants conspired against him and put him to death in his house
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 33:24 (ESV): "And his servants conspired against him and put him to death in his house."

questions.question: Who made Josiah king?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 33:25 (ESV): "...And the people of the land made Josiah his son king in his place."

questions.question: Where was Manasseh buried?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 33:20 (ESV): "So Manasseh slept with his fathers, and they buried him in his house..."

questions.question: What horrible act did Manasseh perform in the Valley of the Son of Hinnom?
options: He burned his sons as an offering
questions.correctAnswer: He burned his sons as an offering
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 33:6 (ESV): "And he burned his sons as an offering in the Valley of the Son of Hinnom..."

questions.question: What did Manasseh put in the house of God?
options: A carved image of the idol that he had made
questions.correctAnswer: A carved image of the idol that he had made
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 33:7 (ESV): "And the carved image of the idol that he had made he set in the house of God..."

key_verse_text: And when he prayed to him, God was moved by his entreaty and heard his plea and brought him again to Jerusalem into his kingdom. Then Manasseh knew that the LORD was God.
